additional_info.subject: Related to the jira ticket for R&D
Handover to ES
additional_info.body:
• Problem Description: IMD_BC1error flag active with reason
IMD deactivated for test purposes
• Action Performed: Analysed logs on SCB. Found the IMB_BC1 error flag is active on 22nd onwards with reason being Modbus communication failure, however the error flags show IMD deactivated for test purposes. Hard and Soft rebooted the charger, but fault still remains.
• Charger SW Version: 6.1.3
• Reason for Handover: Troubleshooting, deep dive into logs.
• Fault history: NA
Charger is out of warranty since March 2025, however since its been only 1 month since the charger went out of warranty, I provided support.
Also, unable to create child case as ISP bug.
